periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation with a downward-forward tilt of approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval, with a longitudinal-to-transverse ratio of approximately 2:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced tapering where the lowest point extends approximately one-third of the total patch length below the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shape with a nearly linear posterior margin across the dorsal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness, occupying approximately 30% of the total visible length of the torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Significant separation distance, approximately 1.5 times the individual horizontal width of a pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, continuous semicircular curvature at the superior boundaries of the ears.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, irregular dark region of fur thinning or matted soiling is visible on the right posterior flank.
other_distinctive_markers: The typically white regions of the pelage exhibit a pervasive yellowish-brown chromatic shift, particularly on the dorsal and caudal areas.
